en: Black‑and‑white view of a broad cobblestoned town square with a Gothic‑style church centered in the background, featuring a rose window and pointed portal. To the right is a block of three‑ and two‑story townhouses with painted shop signs and awnings at street level. The facades carry German‑language commercial signage, including a restaurant and other businesses. On the left side of the square stand older multi‑story buildings; a few pedestrians walk across the open plaza toward the camera. The overall scene suggests a Central European small city around the turn of the 20th century.
